body:
New g_custom_level_ground_plane_enabled/_squares (physics.h) threaded through phys_set_custom_level; resolve_collision's own real, existing 'no terrain -> flat floor at y=0' fallback made conditional + bounded specifically for SCENE_CUSTOM_LEVEL (every other scene's own behavior completely unchanged). packages/world/level_boxes.h: new level_boxes_parse_bool + ground plane fields parsed from NOCK's export JSON. Live-verified end to end against a real running server instance with temporary in-process resolve_collision probes (not just a build check): enabled+in-bounds clamps to floor and sets on_ground; enabled+out-of-bounds falls through; disabled falls through everywhere. Native compile-check clean for both client and server. Deliberately deferred: visual integration with the existing magenta-glow footstep trail effect / bounded Matrix-floor rendering -- the glow itself is already free (on_ground-driven), only the static grid-line rendering bound is still native-only work, logged separately. Commit 64dc726.

⚓ ☃
title: S459-08: real ground-plane collision (enabled + bounded footprint) for NOCK-authored levels
